entities.name: Sifa Grent
entities.description: Human planeswalker from Grixis, death mage and archenemy of Dack Fayden, main antagonist of the IDW comic.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: Planeswalker thief and Sifa Grent's archenemy, with psychometry.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Tiny plane that was Sifa's home.

entities.name: Ancient Fang
entities.description: Artifact Sifa used to regain her youth and Dack used to track her.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: Demon who tried to steal Sifa's spark to escape Grixis.

entities.name: Titan Collector
entities.description: Being Sifa had been in contact with.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: Plane where Sifa slaughtered everyone in Drakeston.

entities.name: Drakeston
entities.description: Town on Fiora whose people Sifa slaughtered.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: Vampire clan whose Baron allied with Sifa.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where Sifa plotted to drain Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The City Tree on Ravnica Sifa plotted to drain.

events.summary: Sifa ascends as a planeswalker when the demon Malfegor tries to steal her spark.
events.quote: Sifa ascended when the demon Malfegor tried to steal Sifa's spark

events.summary: Sifa slaughters everyone in Drakeston in search of Dack Fayden.
events.quote: Sifa slaughtered everyone in Drakeston in search of Dack Fayden

events.summary: Dack tracks Sifa to Innistrad, where she assaults a village allied with him.
events.quote: Sifa assaulted the village that had allied itself with Dack.

events.summary: Dack lets Sifa flee rather than see the village destroyed.
events.quote: had to make the tough choice to let Sifa flee rather than see the village destroyed at her hands

events.summary: Dack deduces Sifa's plan to drain Vitu-Ghazi and rushes to confront her.
events.quote: Dack rushed to the City Tree, arriving just in time to confront her and her forces

events.summary: A colleague of Dack stabs Sifa from behind at the cost of his life.
events.quote: One of Dack's colleagues managed to stab her from behind

events.summary: Dack kills Sifa with his most powerful spell.
events.quote: cut loose with his most powerful spell, bringing vengeance upon the death mage at last

relations.quote: cut loose with his most powerful spell, bringing vengeance upon the death mage at last

relations.note: Allied with a Baron of the clan.
relations.quote: she had allied herself with a Baron of the Falkenrath clan
